responsibility: Is the autogenerated documentation-link companion for gcc/config/arm/arm-tables.opt. In the GCC option-generation pipeline, .opt.urls files map option-table entries to manual URL suffixes so diagnostics, help, or generated metadata can reference the correct documentation page. Because arm-tables.opt is the generated enum table for Arm CPU, architecture, and FPU names rather than ordinary documented switches, this companion currently contains only the autogenerated header and serves as the placeholder URL map for that option fragment.
